Message:
[PATCH] fs: Use ARRAY_SIZE macro

Use ARRAY_SIZE macro instead of sizeof(x)/sizeof(x[0]) and remove a
duplicate of ARRAY_SIZE.  Some trailing whitespaces are also deleted.
